slopeFactorsComment: actualSlopeArea = planArea * (1 / cos(pitchRadians)). Used when the user gives a PLAN/footprint area; skipped when they give the actual roof surface area.

perimeterHeuristics.comment: When the user has not given linear dimensions, ridge/hip/valley/gutter lengths are estimated from roof area + shape with conservative ratios. Each assumption is stated on the estimate.

reroffBundles.comment: Re-roof per-m2 items already include underlay, battens, fixings, verge and labour. These components are itemised for transparency using their upgrade rates only when explicitly chosen.

rounding.rule: Round each line subtotal and the total UP to the nearest 10 dollars (commercial conservative rounding). Quantities rounded up to the nearest 0.5 m2 / lm.

disclaimer: Indicative estimate only - not a formal quote. Subject to free site inspection, timber condition, and final material selection.
standardAssumptions: Pitch assumed 30 degrees if not supplied
Linear component lengths (ridge, hips, valleys, gutters) estimated from area and roof shape - actual lengths may vary
Waste allowance of 7.5% included on covering material
No scaffolding beyond standard single-storey access
Existing roof structure assumed sound - timber repairs priced separately if needed
